title: Cajun Spiced Salmon with Rice and Green Beans
summary: Flaky salmon coated in smoky Cajun spices, served with fluffy rice and crisp-tender green beans. It’s a simple, satisfying dinner with plenty of bold flavour.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it according to the package instructions until tender and fluffy.
Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion, oregano, thyme, cayenne, black pepper and 1 teaspoon of the salt in a small bowl.
Pat the salmon dry and rub the Cajun spice mix all over the fillets.
Bring a pan of salted water to the boil and cook the green beans for 3 to 4 minutes until bright green and just tender. Drain and set aside.

Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the salmon for 3 to 4 minutes on the first side, then 2 to 3 minutes on the second side, until cooked through and lightly charred at the edges.
Add the butter and remaining olive oil to the green beans in a pan, then toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy and hot. Season with the remaining salt.
Serve the salmon with the rice and green beans, and finish with lemon wedges or a squeeze of lemon juice.
